slow_vs_drift.gain_verdict: the correction applied is far larger than the between-day difference, so the gain difference is within reach of an error in the drift model and is not evidence about the screw
slow_vs_drift.slow_verdict: the correction D2 applied moves s(x) by nothing, so the s(x) difference is either a real day-to-day change or drift curvature *within* a segment, which three reference visits cannot see. Not separable here; more reference visits would separate it.

homing_check.sign_convention: compared on magnitude; MSCNT's direction relative to the harmonic phase convention is not fixed by the log

model_free.note: the deviation at a target reproduces to this, before any model and including the sessions' smooth terms

paired_own_models.note: each session fitted on its own, so the residuals share only physics; this is the test Q3 asks for

paired_pooled_model.note: not a test of the physics: shared parameters induce this correlation. Use paired_own_models.

limitations.E3_drift: the reference moved -5.41 um over the session against a +-0.5 um criterion, and not linearly: see drift_variant_robustness for which results survive D0/D1/D2 and which do not
limitations.E3_reversal: beta0 is not identifiable in this session; B carries the full drift over the up-to-down gap
limitations.environment: neither session recorded air or stage temperature, so a gain difference cannot be attributed thermally and the E3 drift cannot be confirmed as thermal
limitations.model_D_gp: section 7.3 structured GP not run; it is marked optional and the P-spline posterior bands already carry the smoothness uncertainty
